title: Exact fulfillment-slot capacity-source exact-revision read
upstream: Canonical FOOD-007C exact SKU historical reader as architectural precedent.

selector.validation: Exact own data keys. Reject missing/extra/symbol/inherited-only fields and accessors without invoking getters. Reuse validateFoodFulfillmentMethod and validateFoodVersion. References are nonempty unpadded strings up to 512 characters, matching FOOD-005V. No trimming or coercion.
selector.capture: Detached frozen selector before database access.

canonicalValidation.identity: Require validated method/locationReference/windowReference/revision to exactly match selector.

database.predicate: method = ? AND location_reference = ? AND window_reference = ? AND revision = ?
database.limitRationale: Detect unexpected multiplicity and fail closed despite database uniqueness expectations.
database.selectAttempts: At most one. No fallback, retry, alternate query, or latest selection.
database.sessions: Injected prepare/bind/all reader only; no session creation or stronger consistency promise.

storageBehavior.envelope: Require object with success === true and array results.
storageBehavior.oneRow: Require seven own data columns; reconstruct canonical durable value and validate exact identity.
storageBehavior.faults: Malformed envelope/row, explicit unsuccessful result, wrong identity, or prepare/bind/all exception yields storage-failure. No public validation exception.

numericSemantics: Positive safe revision; nonnegative safe capacity. Zero and maximum safe capacity/revision allowed. No clamping or revision continuity inspection.
safeClaim: A structurally valid stored historical fulfillment-slot capacity-source assertion was returned for the requested exact slot identity and revision.
fulfillmentIntentLimitation: No fulfillment-intent resolution or persistence. Future reference-only acceptance needs separate intent-resolution/trust design.
reservationLifecycleLimitation: No canonical active reservation lifecycle is supplied or inferred. No aggregation, consumption, release, or expiration.
sourceReferenceLimitation: Persisted reference string, not authenticated truth; structural validation does not authenticate the writer.
freshnessCurrentness: None. No clock, age/expiration check, latest lookup, or governing/acceptance eligibility claim.
separation: No reservation tables, physical inventory, FOOD-005L evidence creation, runtime routes, or consumers. FOOD-005D is not made executable.
next: Discover next prerequisite toward complete request composition / trusted source resolution / lifecycle / atomic acceptance.
